caption: The drawing shows a hunting scene composed of earthy brown and yellow tones. In the scene, two human figures dressed in old-fashioned hats and clothing are positioned on either side, each holding a rifle and aiming toward the center. In the foreground, there are two horses with harnesses, one positioned next to the figure on the right and the other mostly out of frame on the left. A dog is depicted on the left, attentively facing the center. The central focus is a deer leaping over rocky terrain and grass. The background consists of seven stylized trees with different shapes and foliage, standing against a yellow background that fills the entire upper part of the drawing. The lower part of the scene is anchored by brown ground and shrubs below the animals and humans.
title: Bandbox Design (Rabbit Hunt)
